title: Differential Lease Orchestrator and Reachability Prober for Dedicated Fleets
author: Miranda Chen
description:
Context and motivation: Dedicated fleets occasionally observe long-lived reservations that are reachable by control plane health checks but no longer actively serving tenant requests (warm-but-idle). This leads to headroom parked in spots that could be used for bursty workloads, and it complicates aggressive autoscaling because the system overestimates available capacity.

What this PR does: Implements a Differential Lease Orchestrator (DLO) and a lightweight Reachability Prober to improve the accuracy of dedicated capacity accounting and enable safer re-use of warm slots. The DLO introduces a two-tier lease model (soft leases and hard leases) with a small, probabilistic revocation path for soft leases when utilization signals indicate sustained underuse. The Reachability Prober runs concurrent, low-cost probes against service processes on dedicated nodes to detect subtle warm-but-stalled states (e.g., KV cache present but request handler event-loop stalled) and annotate leases with a reachability score.

Key behavior changes: 1) Soft leases: short-duration (default 2m) renewals with low-cost token checks; can be probabilistically decoupled in batches to free slots under stress. 2) Hard leases: longer-duration (default 30m) reservations tied to contractual commitments; only revoked after staged decommitment signals. 3) Differential revocation: when cluster-level headroom is low, the DLO targets soft leases first, scoring candidates by reachability, recent served QPS, and runway (how long a tenant can tolerate reduced capacity). 4) Staged decommit: before evicting a hard lease, the system performs a staged reduction (reduce concurrency/slots) and emits a decommit advisory to the tenant control channel to allow graceful degradation.

Telemetry and reporting: Adds a tenant_utilization_reporter that emits: recent_served_tokens, reserved_tokens, reachability_score, lease_type, last_probe_ok, and a 99/95/50 latency token-percentile for served requests. Exposes new cluster-level metrics: soft_lease_reclaim_rate, probe_failure_ratio, staged_decommit_count, and reclaimed_headroom_pool. These metrics are intended for SLO dashboards and autoscaler tuning.

Safety and rollout: The feature is behind a runtime flag (dlo.enabled) and gated per-dedicated-fleet via a new FleetConfig.delta_lease_policy. Default policy is conservative (no hard lease revocations in first 30 days). We include canary steps: 5% of fleets opt-in, monitor probe false-positive rate (<0.5%) and reclaimed headroom vs. observed burst success rate.

Checklist:
- [x] Core orchestrator logic and reconciliation loop
- [x] Reachability prober with backoff and jitter
- [x] Staged decommit path and advisory channel hooks
- [x] Telemetry reporter and metrics export
- [x] Unit and integration tests (repro scenarios for warm-but-idle)
- [x] Feature flag and FleetConfig field

Why this is different from existing autoscaler work: Rather than changing scale velocity or headroom heuristics globally, this PR focuses on reclaiming wasted capacity produced by lease semantics and subtle reachability failures. It complements predictive autoscalers (which forecast demand) by improving actual allocation precision and enabling safer transient reallocation for burst requests.

Changed files (high level): ["services/dlo/orchestrator.go", "services/dlo/prober.go", "services/dlo/state.go", "pkg/telemetry/tenant_reporter.go", "api/v1/fleet_config.proto", "cmd/agent/main.go (flag wiring)", "docs/ops/dlo-design.md", "tests/integration/dlo_reclaim_test.go", "charts/values/dlo_canary.yaml"]

Review conversation (high level):
- Raj: "This looks promising; two concerns: probe overhead and false positives could introduce flapping. Can we bound probe RPS and add a max-stale-duration?"
- Miranda: "Added probe concurrency limiter (default 50 keys/sec per fleet) and a max_stale_duration config param. Tests added to show no flapping under 2x probe rate."
- Sofia: "Telemetry will be noisy at first; suggest histogram buckets for reachability_score."
- Miranda: "Converted reachability_score to an int8 bucket and added 5 buckets (0-4) to the exporter. Dashboard snippet included in docs."
- Evan: "Staged decommit path needs a clear tenant advisory contract — what happens if tenant rejects the advisory?"
- Miranda: "If advisory is not acknowledged within the grace window, we escalate to soft-decommit followed by hard revocation after an override window. These timeouts are conservative and tunable via FleetConfig."

CI and validation: Full unit test suite and dlo integration tests run. E2E smoke on a 3-node dedicated cluster validated: 1) reclaimed soft leases freed ~12% headroom during idle periods; 2) probe false-positive rate measured at 0.12% over 24h in canary. CI details: build (pass), unit-tests (pass), integration (pass, flaky test retried once), lint (pass), govet (pass).

Merge notes: Squash-and-merge after final sign-off. Release notes: "Introduce Differential Lease Orchestrator (opt-in): improved reclamation of warm-but-idle slots with reachability probing and staged decommit. Metrics: soft_lease_reclaim_rate, reclaim_headroom_pool, tenant_utilization_reporter fields. Controlled rollout via FleetConfig.delta_lease_policy and runtime flag dlo.enabled."
